summary.intent: Land the open PRs, then start the small follow-up PR: make `just lint` run `typos` so it matches CI, and diagnose the two zod misses (`name` ranked 6th, `second` absent) in the rg-compare harness, before moving on to hit-first retrieval.
summary.outcome: PR #57 was fixed (typos failure) and merged, with #54-#58 all merged and only release PR #59 open. A new branch has `typos` added to the lint recipe, the rg-compare harness tightened (top-level definitions only, `.d.ts` excluded, 90% gate), and a commit made. The PR itself is not yet confirmed opened.

repo: `just lint` did not run `typos`, but CI does, so local lint passed while CI Lint failed on #57. The fix is to add `typos` to the lint recipe.
`typos` flags `caf` (from `caf\xe9` in test strings) as a misspelling of `calf`; the tests now use `zed` instead.
zod, zustand and axios are public repos cloned by `just rg-compare` as test inputs, listed in `scripts/rg-compare.repos` and pinned by commit. They are not monokl dependencies.
monokl excludes `.d.ts` files from search by design (documented in the README), so declarations that exist only in `.d.ts` (e.g. `AxiosPromise`) return nothing. The harness must exclude them too.
Baseline: declarations rank well (39 of 41 in the top 3), but monokl takes about 50 ms versus rg's roughly 10 ms on bare lookups.
The Entire Gates check can fail with 0 findings and clear on rerun, so a failure with no findings may be stale.
Release PR #59 (Callisto) bundles #55's library-API minor changeset plus the lossy-read and parent-ignore patches; merging it publishes a release.

code.finding: The lint recipe was edited to run `typos` first so local lint matches CI.
The harness was changed to count only top-level definitions, exclude `.d.ts` files, and enforce a 90% gate; it exits 0 above the gate.

workflow: Agents ran `just lint` and `just test` but not `typos`; running the full CI recipe (minus coverage) locally avoids this class of failure.
Check what a harness measures against product design (here, `.d.ts` exclusion) before treating a miss as a product bug.
The user's repo-specific preference: arktype is only for validation use, so it is not added to the search harness.

friction: #57 failed CI because local lint and CI checks diverged on `typos`.
Entire Gates failed with no visible findings, making the cause unclear until a rerun.
The sharper top-level-only rule surfaced an apparent `AxiosPromise` miss that turned out to be the by-design `.d.ts` exclusion, costing a detour.
open_items: Open the PR for the typos-in-lint and harness changes, and confirm its CI passes.
Finish diagnosing the zod misses (`name` ranked 6th, `second` absent): ranking or extraction.

Decide when to merge release PR #59 after reading its rendered changelog; its checks were not verified.
Housekeeping: remove stale agent worktrees and close trails 183, 185, 190 and 191.
